title: Meowth Can't Stop Picking Up Shiny Things, and Its Coin Shines
premise: When Meowth sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
audiencePromise: Show why shiny objects trigger Meowth's coin and eyes to shine.
openLoop: What else happens when Meowth spots something shiny?
payoff: One shiny sight connects Meowth's coin, glittering eyes, and picking habit.

voice.instructions: Warm and quick, like telling a friend a strange Pokédex detail. Stress the words "shiny" and "coin." Pause briefly before the coin and eye reveals, then land the final question playfully.

scenes.headline: IT CANNOT STOP
scenes.narration: Meowth can't stop. Its coin shines at shiny objects.
scenes.caption: SHINY OBJECTS TRIGGER THE COIN

scenes.headline: LOOSE CHANGE CALLS
scenes.narration: At night, Meowth searches streets for dropped loose change.
scenes.caption: IT SEARCHES AT NIGHT

scenes.headline: THE COIN LIGHTS UP
scenes.narration: See a shiny object, and the gold coin on its head shines.
scenes.caption: SHINY OBJECT → SHINING COIN

scenes.headline: ITS EYES JOIN IN
scenes.narration: When Meowth spots shine, its eyes glitter brightly too.
scenes.caption: THE EYES GLITTER TOO

scenes.headline: PICKUP IS UNSTOPPABLE
scenes.narration: It can't stop itself from picking shiny things up.
scenes.caption: IT CANNOT STOP PICKING THEM UP
